commits.title: A logged time entry can be corrected in Work: Edit beside Delete

changes.how: entryAccess() (line 352) returns two more fields; its return type becomes `{ note: boolean; edit: boolean; editDay: boolean; delete: boolean; why: string | null }`. `edit` is true exactly where `delete` is true (every field may change). `editDay` is true exactly where `note` is true (so also on a draft invoice, where the server lets only the day and the note change: updateTimeEntry() in src/server/work-time.ts answers ON_DRAFT for anything else). The four returns become: not mine `{ note: false, edit: false, editDay: false, delete: false, why: "Logged by someone else" }`; locked `{ note: false, edit: false, editDay: false, delete: false, why: "On an issued invoice" }`; draft `{ note: true, edit: false, editDay: true, delete: false, why: "On a draft invoice" }`; else `{ note: true, edit: true, editDay: true, delete: true, why: null }`. Update the doc comment: 'on a draft invoice only the day and the note change'.

The three exact expectations near lines 342, 347 and 352 use toEqual on the whole object: add the two new fields to each (own entry: edit true, editDay true; draft: edit false, editDay true; paid and locked: both false). Add one case 'offers Edit where Delete is offered, and only the day on a draft invoice' that checks the four states (own, someone else's for a non-owner, draft, locked) for edit and editDay.
